name: RuleEngine::audit_manifest

test_list.description: No registry or invented package list is substituted when the caller supplies no trusted baseline.
An exact normalized match to a caller-supplied baseline never reports as a typo.
A bounded near-name heuristic counts a common adjacent transposition as one edit and reports provenance with no CWE.
Tied nearest baseline names are returned in deterministic order and marked ambiguous.
Cargo dependency aliases resolve to the declared upstream package name.
Bounded package.json and Python requirement inputs use their supported dependency sections.
PEP 503 case and separator runs normalize consistently for exact exclusions.
Manifest, package-count, name-length and comparison budgets reject work without partial findings.
Path length is bounded before finding path copies are allocated.
Unknown file formats report unsupported coverage without parsing arbitrary text.

inputs.name: manifest_baseline
inputs.description: A bounded caller-owned Cargo, npm, or Python manifest and optional trusted known-package baseline; no network lookup is performed.

output_description: Deterministic informational near-name review findings with exact-package exclusions, explicit baseline status, bounded restricted Damerau-Levenshtein distance (adjacent transpositions count as one), ambiguity, and no CWE mapping.
